oddities: Labels for email, amount and term point to ids that do not exist (for=loanEmail, loanAmount, number) - labels are not linked to their inputs; only income and age labels are linked.
No min/max/pattern attributes on any number field - the form itself does not state any limit.
Only term is required; email, amount, income and age can be left empty as far as the client validation goes.
An invalid form shows no validation message - the submit is silently ignored and the form gets ng-submitted + ng-invalid.
No business rule is stated on the form page or on /loans; the rules appear only on the result page after a denial.

otherPages./loans: Loan home: 'Financing for what ever life throws at you! Use our loan calculator to see if you qualify for a loan with UiBank' - no rules stated.
